patches.notes: src/core/environ/switch/SwitchUtils.cpp: reads sdmc:/switch/kirikiroid2/autostart.txt and calls startupFrom() so the engine boots straight into a game instead of the file picker.

src/core/environ/switch/main.cpp: GalNX_MaybeExtractGame() copies the RomFS payload listed in game_files.txt to sdmc on first boot, with a statvfs free-space precheck, MkDirs, marker versioning and stat checks.
src/plugins/InternalPlugins.cpp: retries plugin names ending in .tpm as .dll so the built-in NCB modules register (windowEx and friends).

portlibs.name: ffmpeg
portlibs.notes: K2 1.3.9 uses pre-5.0 FFmpeg APIs, so devkitPro FFmpeg 7.1 is not a substitute; NEON asm needs relocate=1 for PIE.

portlibs.name: opencv
portlibs.notes: BUILD_LIST=core,imgproc; CV_CPU_NEON/FP16 are patched on for __SWITCH__.

portlibs.name: unrar
portlibs.notes: Static RARDLL build with a newlib utimensat fix; the UnRAR license restricts redistribution.

portlibs.name: libbpg
portlibs.notes: Decoder only, plus the gray-line fix patch.

portlibs.name: jxrlib
portlibs.notes: UNPINNED upstream master; rebuilds may drift, tracked as a reproducibility risk.

portlibs.name: blend2d
portlibs.notes: The recipe clones and checks out this commit; __SWITCH__ takes the Apple 64-bit off_t branch.
